text:
Taylor R.: FYI HeliosMed requested a dedicated POC pool for EU data residency (eu-central-1). They prefer H100 but asked for an A100 fallback. Need sizing, CIDR, and whether we can do a 45-day POC with waived commit.
Priya M.: What's the workload profile? latency SLO, avg tokens, burst patterns?
Taylor R.: Target ~150 qps for short clinical chat flows, p95 <=300ms on 1024-token contexts, demo spikes up to 500 qps for 10-15 min. Team: 4 devs + 2 infra. Need org KMS and private control plane (they're regulated).
Jonas L.: H100 will hit latency goals at lower GPU count. Suggest 3xH100 for baseline, enable burst to cover demo spikes. Alternative: 6xA100-80GB for more concurrency with slightly higher p95.
Priya M.: Security checklist: SOC2 answers, customer-managed KMS, VPC peering + IP allowlist, logs retention policy. They also asked for a sample SLA for the POC and billing for trial period.
Taylor R.: They want a quote: 3xH100 vs 6xA100 for 45 days. Also need an example rictl command to hand to their network team for CIDR approval.
Jonas L.: Minimal CIDR: /28 for peering. If private control plane, we need an extra /28 for control plane interfaces. For hosted Dedicated we need one /28.
Jonas L.: Example CLI to speed their approver: 
```
rictl pool create --name heliosmed-poc --region eu-central-1 \
  --sku h100 --count 3 --burst-enabled true \
  --control-plane private --vpc-peer-cidr 10.45.32.0/28 \
  --kms-key arn:aws:kms:eu-central-1:987654321000:key/xyz987 \
  --contact security:helios@heliosmed.com
```
Priya M.: On the billing side: we can authorize a 45-day trial credit but need Ops signoff to waive the usual monthly commit. I'll escalate.
Taylor R.: Can ops provision within 72 hours after PO + CIDR? We need to schedule a demo next week.
OpsBot: Provisioning request logged. Ticket #POC-9438 created. Ops review ETA: 1 business day.
Jonas L.: Perf estimates (very rough): 3xH100 should handle sustained 150 qps with p95 ~200-280ms for 1024 tokens with batching. 6xA100 gives higher concurrency; expect p95 ~320-420ms. Burst handling will reduce dropped requests during demo.
Priya M.: Sales note: include a token-level cost estimate in the quote. Finance to give final numbers.
Taylor R.: I've asked Helios infra lead for CIDR and PO contact. Asked them to confirm dev IPs for key allowlist.
Helios Infra (external): We'll provide 10.45.32.0/28 and list of dev IPs by EOD. PO approval in process.
Taylor R.: Great. Once PO + CIDR land we'll request ops to spin the pool and share API keys with IP restrictions.
Jonas L.: Add a canary route and model pinning to allow automatic fallback to a quantized variant if latency degrades. Also enable token-level logging for audit.
OpsBot: Ticket #POC-9438 updated - assignee: @Jonas L. - requested provisioning window: 2026-04-06 08:00 UTC.
Taylor R.: Thanks team - I'll follow up with Helios and close the loop. :white_check_mark:
